*{box-sizing:border-box}

.sheet>*{position:relative}
section,footer{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
nav{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:22px;padding:20px 0 0}
nav a{font:600 .8rem var(--disp);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);text-decoration:none;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--head);border-bottom-color:var(--head)}
h1,h2,h3{color:var(--head);font-family:var(--disp);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,7vw,2.6rem);line-height:1.05;margin:34px 0 14px}
h3{font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:600}
p{margin:0 0 12px}
.mut{color:var(--mut)}
a{color:var(--acc)}
.hero{max-width:none;text-align:center;padding:34px 0 10px}
.tiny{font:600 .72rem/1.6 var(--disp);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);margin:0}
.tiny b{color:var(--fg)}
.tiny a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,15vw,7.5rem);line-height:.95;font-weight:700;margin:26px 0 22px}
.fans{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:14px 0 34px}
.fan{position:relative;display:block;text-decoration:none;width:clamp(96px,27vw,200px);aspect-ratio:1;margin:0 -6px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--frame);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2);transform:var(--t);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.fan:hover,.fan:focus-visible{transform:var(--t) scale(1.12);z-index:3;box-shadow:0 20px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.avatar,.theme{transition:transform .2s}
.avatar:hover,.theme:hover{transform:scale(1.12)}
.f1{--t:rotate(-7deg) translateY(10px)}
.f2{--t:rotate(3deg) translateY(-8px);z-index:1}
.f3{--t:rotate(8deg) translateY(6px)}
.fan img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.fan span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;font:700 clamp(.75rem,3.4vw,1.1rem) var(--disp);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--head)}
.ghost{font:700 clamp(2.4rem,11vw,5.2rem)/1 var(--disp);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ghost);margin:0 0 40px}
.photo{float:left;width:96px;height:124px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:4px 16px 8px 0;border:3px solid var(--card);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
#about::after{content:"";display:block;clear:both}
.avatar{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:14px;right:14px;width:46px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid var(--card);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);background:var(--card)}
.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.theme{position:fixed;z-index:5;right:18px;bottom:18px;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--card);color:var(--head);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.theme svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round}
.tip{position:fixed;z-index:5;right:76px;bottom:28px;background:var(--head);color:var(--paper);font:600 .75rem var(--disp);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:99px}
@media(min-width:700px){.avatar{top:20px;right:20px}.theme{right:28px;bottom:28px}.tip{right:86px;bottom:38px}}
iframe{width:100%;height:480px;border:0;margin:10px 0;border-radius:10px}
#map{height:320px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}
.job{margin-bottom:14px}
.job b{display:block}
ul{margin:4px 0 0;padding-left:20px}
.chips span{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);border-radius:99px;padding:1px 12px;margin:0 6px 6px 0;font-size:.9rem}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.track{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;padding:4px 0 16px}
.track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.slide{flex:0 0 100%;min-width:0;scroll-snap-align:start;padding:0 2px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.07)}
.card>h3{font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.03em}
.card small{display:block;color:var(--mut);margin:4px 0}
.card img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:10px 0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}
.more{margin-top:12px;font:600 .8rem var(--disp);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--head);background:none;border:2px solid var(--head);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 18px;cursor:pointer}
.body{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:12px;padding-top:2px}
.body h3{font-size:.85rem;margin:12px 0 2px}
.body p{margin:0}
.ctl{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ctl button{font:inherit;color:var(--head);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;width:38px;height:38px;cursor:pointer}
.ctl button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
.ctl .dot{width:12px;height:12px;padding:0;background:var(--line)}
.ctl .dot[aria-current=true]{background:var(--head);border-color:var(--head)}
footer{margin-top:40px;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px}
footer h2{font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.16em;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--mut)}
footer p{margin:0 0 4px}
</style>
</head>

<div class="sheet">

  <h1>Libby Signor</h1>

  <p class="ghost">GIS Student, Texas A&amp;M</p>
  <p class="tiny"><b>Internships include</b><br>Matador Resources Company, Republic Property Group</p>
</section>

<section id="about" data-page="home">
  <h2>About</h2>
  <img class="photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Headshot of Libby Signor">
  <p>I am completing a BS in Geographic Information Science and Technology at Texas A&amp;M University (December 2026 candidate, 3.65 major GPA). I transferred in as a junior from the College of Engineering to the Department of Geography.</p>
  <p>I have interned as the first GIS intern at Matador Resources Company (Summer 2026) and Republic Property Group (Summer 2025), working with ArcGIS Pro, Esri Field Maps and Python. Outside of GIS, my interests are fly fishing, literature, baking and travel.</p>
  <p><a href="#projects">See my projects</a> &middot; <a href="#resume">View my resume</a></p>
</section>

<section id="projects" data-page="projects">
  <h2>Projects</h2>
  <p class="mut">Swipe or use the arrows to browse. Tap More for details.</p>

  <div class="car">
    <div class="track" tabindex="0" aria-label="Projects">
    <div class="slide"><div class="card">
      <h3>Valles Caldera National Preserve: Hunting and Fishing Areas</h3>
      <small>GEOG 395: Cartography and Geovisualization, February 2026</small>
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Map titled Valles Caldera National Preserve, Hunting and Fishing Areas, by Libby Signor">
      <button class="more" aria-expanded="false">More</button>
      <div class="body" hidden>
      <h3>The problem</h3>
      <p>[ADD]</p>
      <h3>What I did</h3>
      <p>I designed a map of Valles Caldera National Preserve showing hunting and fishing areas. It shows the fishing area and closed areas, authorized motor vehicle routes, e-bike access routes, hike/bike/equestrian trails, trailheads, horse trailer parking, and the entrance and ranger stations, with a locator inset and scale bar.</p>

    </div></div>

      <small>GEOG 395: Cartography and Geovisualization, [ADD] date</small>
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Site map titled East Villas, The Villas at Ridgeline Vista, by Libby Signor">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Site map titled West Villas, The Villas at Ridgeline Vista, by Libby Signor">
      <button class="more" aria-expanded="false">More</button>
      <div class="body" hidden>
      <h3>The problem</h3>
      <p>[ADD]</p>
      <h3>What I did</h3>
      <p>I designed a matching pair of site maps for The Villas at Ridgeline Vista, split into East Villas and West Villas. Each map labels every unit by building and unit number and color-codes it as a 2, 3 or 4 bedroom unit, with the surrounding streets and alleys named, a legend and a north arrow.</p>

    <div class="slide"><div class="card">
      <h3>Crater Lake: Topography and Bathymetry</h3>
      <small>GEOG 395: Cartography and Geovisualization, March 2026</small>
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Map titled Crater Lake, Topography and Bathymetry, by Libby Signor">
      <button class="more" aria-expanded="false">More</button>
      <div class="body" hidden>
      <h3>The problem</h3>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
// Map data lives here. [ADD] points as {name, lat, lng, note}, for example:
// {name:"[ADD]", lat:0, lng:0, note:"[ADD]"}
var POINTS = [];

(function () {
  var el = document.getElementById("map");
  if (!window.L) { el.innerHTML = "<p style='padding:16px'>Map library could not load.</p>"; return; }
  var map = window.siteMap = L.map("map").setView([32.78, -96.8], 9); // Dallas, TX area (home city on resume)
  L.tileLayer("https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Topo_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", {
    attribution: "Tiles © Esri", maxZoom: 19
  }).addTo(map);
  var group = L.featureGroup();
  POINTS.forEach(function (p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng]);
    var box = document.createElement("div");
    var b = document.createElement("b"); b.textContent = p.name;
    var t = document.createElement("div"); t.textContent = p.note || "";
    box.appendChild(b); box.appendChild(t);
    m.bindPopup(box).addTo(group);
  });
  group.addTo(map);
  if (POINTS.length) map.fitBounds(group.getBounds().pad(0.2));
})();

(function () {
  var pages = ["home", "projects", "resume"];
  function show() {
    var p = location.hash.slice(1);
    if (pages.indexOf(p) < 0) p = "home";
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-page]").forEach(function (s) { s.hidden = s.dataset.page !== p; });
    document.querySelectorAll("nav a").forEach(function (a) {
      if (a.getAttribute("href") === "#" + p) a.setAttribute("aria-current", "page"); else a.removeAttribute("aria-current");
    });
    if (p === "projects") {
      if (window.siteMap) window.siteMap.invalidateSize();
      var t = document.querySelector(".track");
      if (window.pendingSlide != null) { t.scrollLeft = window.pendingSlide * t.clientWidth; window.pendingSlide = null; }
    }
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", show);
  show();
})();

(function () {
  var track = document.querySelector(".track"), slides = track.children, dots = document.querySelector(".dots");
  var prev = document.querySelector(".prev"), next = document.querySelector(".next");
  function go(i) { track.scrollTo({ left: i * track.clientWidth, behavior: "smooth" }); }
  function cur() { return Math.round(track.scrollLeft / (track.clientWidth || 1)); }
  function sync() {
    var i = cur();
    prev.disabled = i <= 0; next.disabled = i >= slides.length - 1;
    [].forEach.call(dots.children, function (d, k) { d.setAttribute("aria-current", k === i); });
  }
  [].forEach.call(slides, function (s, k) {
    var d = document.createElement("button"); d.className = "dot"; d.setAttribute("aria-label", "Project " + (k + 1));
    d.onclick = function () { go(k); }; dots.appendChild(d);
    var b = s.querySelector(".more"), body = s.querySelector(".body");
    b.onclick = function () { var open = body.hidden; body.hidden = !open; b.textContent = open ? "Less" : "More"; b.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open); };
  });
  prev.onclick = function () { go(cur() - 1); };
  next.onclick = function () { go(cur() + 1); };
  track.addEventListener("scroll", sync);
  window.addEventListener("resize", sync);
  sync();
})();

(function () {
  var photo = document.querySelector(".photo"), av = document.querySelector(".avatar img");
  av.src = photo.src;
  var imgs = document.querySelectorAll(".slide");
  document.querySelectorAll(".fan").forEach(function (f) {
    var i = +f.dataset.i, src = imgs[i] && imgs[i].querySelector("img");
    var fi = f.querySelector("img"); if (fi && src) fi.src = src.src;
    f.addEventListener("click", function () { window.pendingSlide = i; });
  });
  var themes = [["water", "Water"], ["topo", "Topo"], ["forest", "Forest"], ["deep", "Deep"]], n = 0, tip = document.querySelector(".tip"), timer;
  function apply(k) { n = k; document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", themes[k][0]); }
  try { var sv = localStorage.getItem("theme"); for (var k = 0; k < themes.length; k++) if (themes[k][0] === sv) apply(k); } catch (e) {}
  document.querySelector(".theme").addEventListener("click", function () {
    apply((n + 1) % themes.length);
    try { localStorage.setItem("theme", themes[n][0]); } catch (e) {}
    tip.textContent = themes[n][1]; tip.hidden = false; clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(function () { tip.hidden = true; }, 1300);
  });
})();
</script>
